answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a kernel for Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital to validate network operations. As the tide of identity inflation rises, the cost for an attacker becomes crystal clear: they must acquire a majority of staked assets to subvert consensus. This economic barrier ensures that identity is bound to tangible value rather than ephemeral digital signatures, forcing any malicious actor to incur significant capital losses to achieve a hostile takeover of the agent ecosystem.
